$comment: Transcribed from the live original (sitemap + headless-Playwright recon in .recon/specs/ and CLONE_SPEC.md) and cross-checked against the clone's pages in src/pages. Template section lists are in page order; responsive-only sections are listed where they render and their scope says at which widths.

meta.clone: this project (React + Vite clone); section implementedBy paths are relative to it

categories.SHELL: Site chrome and runtime UI present across routes: blended nav, menu overlay, custom cursor, live clock, footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening composition of a route (or of one breakpoint's layout of it).
categories.WORK: Portfolio/case-study presentation: project canvases, lists, galleries, teasers and case-study rows.
categories.ABOUT: Studio, team, services, principles, process and careers content.
categories.PROOF: Credibility content: numbers, awards, partner logos, testimonials, case results.
categories.CONVERSION: Contact and enquiry blocks that turn a visitor into a lead.
categories.EDITORIAL: Notes/blog and legal prose: listings, article parts and document bodies.

shell.nav.description: Fixed full-viewport nav layer blended with mix-blend-mode:difference (white text that inverts over imagery): 'Möbius®' wordmark link left; at >=1200 four rolling-letter links WORK/STUDIO/FEED/CONTACT, below 1200 a single MENU button. Zooms in (scale 1.6 to 1, 0.8s spring) on desktop load.

shell.menu-overlay.description: Full-screen black menu opened from MENU below 1200: logo + CLOSE row and four centred 44px links (Work, Studio, Feed, Contact). Opens and closes instantly, no transition. Runtime UI, not page content.
shell.menu-overlay.scope: Available on all 31 routes below 1200px only.

shell.cursor.description: Custom spring-following cursor dot (stiffness 340, damping 60) that swaps variant by hovered region: 20px black dot, 120px dot with arrow / drag / play icon, white, or hidden. Runtime UI.
shell.cursor.scope: Present on all 31 routes at >=1200px only.

shell.clock.description: Live 'BERLIN, DE hh:mm AM' Europe/Berlin clock fixed bottom-right inside the difference-blend nav layer, refreshed every second. Runtime UI.
shell.clock.scope: Present on 29 routes at >=1200px: every route except /work and /feed.

shell.footer.description: Shared footer: fit-width 'Möbius®' wordmark (scroll-linked 6-slat 'blinds' reveal on desktop) with '© 2018-YY', newsletter field with arrow button, Social and Legal link columns with grow-in underline hovers, and the template credit + copyright row. Desktop / Tablet / Mobile variants by breakpoint; /work forces the Tablet variant at every width.
shell.footer.scope: Present on all 31 routes, but /work and /feed render it only below 1200px.

hero.home-card-stack.description: Home opening composition that doubles as the site's 'loader': whole hero fades in from 0.001 and shrinks from scale 1.6 with the nav, then four rotated project cards (−5/−20/−10/+5°) rise 100vh on staggered 1.4–1.1s springs, the intro paragraph reveals line by line and '© 2018-26' rises per character. Cards fan out on hover, fly up on scroll past 30px and replay on return to the top.

hero.work-canvas-title.description: Centred 240px 'Work' title whose letters rise 300px inside a clip after ~1.1s, with 'scroll / drag' fading in beneath; sits under the infinite canvas cards.

hero.works-list-intro.description: Touch-layout page header for the works list: large 'Work' h1 plus a one-sentence intro in grey, followed by a sticky white masking bar.

hero.project-intro.description: Project case-study opening: hero image with left-to-right mask wipe and 0.34x scroll parallax beside the project name, description and services list; scales in from 1.6 on desktop.

hero.studio-intro.description: Studio opening: sticky 'Do you feel ready…' prompt with Join Us anchor link, two intro paragraphs revealed line by line, and a cursor-image trail that spawns 300x400 photos along the pointer path.

hero.feed-list-intro.description: Touch-layout header for the notes list: 'Studio Notes' h1 and balanced intro paragraph with a sticky white bar.

hero.post-intro.description: Article header: date, large title and lead paragraph, zooming in with the nav on desktop.

hero.legal-intro.description: Legal document header: 104px document title and a grey summary paragraph.

hero.not-found.description: 404 composition: three 900-weight digit columns that roll into '404' on a 1.6s spring, coloured by a blurred gradient layer with two continuously rotating shapes (14s / 10s), plus a grey explanation line and an arrow 'Go back home' link.
hero.not-found.scope: Only on /404 (1 route); also rendered for any unknown URL.

work.infinite-canvas.description: Full-viewport draggable/scrollable infinite canvas of the 12 project cards in a 2600x2300 tile repeated 2x2 so it wraps: wheel x0.733 and drag x1.578 with 0.048 per-frame lerp, velocity lag offsets, image zoom to 120% and letter-by-letter project name on hover.

work.works-list.description: Vertical list of the 12 projects (01 to 12) for touch layouts: image with left-to-right mask wipe, bold name and a description paragraph per item.

work.home-reel.description: Home showreel band: two opposite-direction text tickers with scroll-velocity boost above a video with the 'play' cursor that opens a full-screen sound-on lightbox.

work.project-year.description: Large grey sticky "'25" year label pinned bottom-left over the case study on desktop. Decorative.

work.project-text-block.description: Numbered case-study prose row: paragraphs in a 4-column text column with a large grey '/ n' marker to the right on desktop. Appears three times per case study (challenge, approach, outcome).

work.project-quote.description: Case-study pull quote: 56px hanging-indent quote (first line indented 160px, letter-spacing −0.04em) revealed word by word on desktop.

work.project-gallery.description: Four-image case-study gallery in two columns (slots A and D narrower with spacers, B and C full column), heights following each image's orientation, with a sticky white bar.

work.project-credits.description: Credits paragraph (team roles) with the 'Live Project' pill button whose backdrop collapses to a circle on hover.

work.next-project.description: 'Next Project.' teaser: two opposite-direction 100px/s tickers that speed up with scroll, under the next case's card with hover zoom and letter-by-letter name.
work.next-project.scope: On 11 of the 12 /work/<slug> routes (not on the last project, orbit-404).

work.studio-gallery.description: Draggable image ticker of studio photos moving at 100px/s with drag inertia and the 'drag' cursor.

work.featured-project.description: 'Featured Project.' teaser on the studio page: two opposite-direction scroll-boosted tickers under the Golden Hour case card.

about.home-scramble.description: Home studio statement whose words fly in from seeded random offsets (seed 117, spread 1000) as the heading scrolls from viewport bottom to centre, with supporting paragraphs revealed line by line.

about.services.description: Services block: sticky intro column with 'Get Started', a lettered services list with word-staggered statements and service tags.

about.founders.description: Founders cards with scroll-linked column offsets (−200 / −50 to 0) and hover image zoom plus rising name/role.

about.process.description: Process timeline: four steps on a dashed grid whose black bars grow over 1.2s on view, with rising step names and line-revealed texts.

about.studio-team.description: Studio statement revealed one word at a time in a seeded random order (41 words) across a scroll window, then faded out, followed by three team-card columns with scroll parallax (−150 / −300 to 0).

about.principles.description: 'Our Principles.' block: sticky heading with 'Work With Us' link and three lettered principle statements (A/B/C) that appear as they enter the viewport.

about.careers.description: Careers section (#career): heading and paragraph, an accordion of open roles (independent toggles, 0.8s tween, plus icon rotates 45°) and a closing hanging-indent studio quote.

proof.numbers.description: 'In Numbers' sticky digit odometer: a 60%-wide box pinned over three 100vh rows whose 1.6s-spring digit columns and photo crossfade switch state as each row's marker crosses the viewport centre.

proof.awards.description: Awards list (#awards) whose rows rise and fade in, scroll-linked through a heavy spring, with an 'Our Work' link.

proof.partners.description: 'Our Partners' sticky logo grid (#client-logotypes): the heading fades to 0.02 as the grid arrives, logos scale to 1.6 on hover, followed by a full-width image with 1/6-speed parallax.

proof.testimonials.description: 'Client reflections' testimonials: desktop slideshow with 0.3s fade and 10s autoplay plus prev/next; touch layouts use a scroll-snap carousel with dots.

proof.project-numbers.description: Case-study results row: four statistics whose characters rise in sequence on desktop (2x2 grid on phone).

commerce.pricing.description: Pricing plans with a Monthly/Yearly pill toggle (0.4s spring), digit-rolling prices, struck-through yearly comparison and a 'Let's Talk' link.

conversion.lets-talk.description: 'Let's Talk!' fill-in-the-sentence contact form (inline name/email/budget/service fields, select chevrons, 2px focus underline, submit pill with simulated loading then 'Thank you'), beside a sticky 'Do you feel ready…' prompt with Join Us.
conversion.lets-talk.scope: On 2 routes: /contacts (title as h1) and / (title as h2).
conversion.lets-talk.implementedBy: src/pages/Contacts.jsx (ct-talk) and src/components/home/LetsTalk.jsx, both using contacts/ContactForm.jsx

conversion.contact-details.description: Contact image with scroll parallax (300 / 200 / 0 px by breakpoint) and an overlaid card with address lines rising per character, email and phone links with grow-in underlines.

editorial.studio-notes.description: 'Studio Notes' teaser: sticky 'Our thoughts' text with Read All, and the latest two notes (one on tablet/phone) as image cards with mask-wipe reveal and arrow cursor.

editorial.feed-columns.description: Non-scrolling desktop notes wall: three columns of note cards auto-scrolling at different speeds and directions (A up, B down, C up) with wheel boost that permanently flips a column's direction.

editorial.feed-list.description: Touch-layout list of all 11 notes: 60vh mask-wiped image, date, title and excerpt per item.

editorial.post-number.description: Large grey 'N / 11' article index pinned bottom-left of the viewport for the length of the article on desktop and tablet; a static first row on phone.

editorial.post-cover.description: Article cover image at its natural aspect ratio under a sticky white bar, revealed with the left-to-right mask wipe.

editorial.post-body.description: Article prose row: plain paragraphs (max 480px) in a 4-column text column with a grey '/ A' or '/ B' marker on desktop; part B ends with the author line. Appears twice per article.

editorial.post-quote.description: Article pull quote: 56px hanging-indent quote (first line indented 160px, letter-spacing −0.03em) revealed word by word on desktop.

editorial.read-more.description: 'Read More' related-notes block: title rising per character on desktop and two note cards (one below 1200) chosen by position: next and 3rd on the first post, previous and next in the middle, previous and 1st on the last.

editorial.legal-updated.description: 'Last updated' date block: a sticky 100vh box pinned bottom-left over the whole document on desktop, a normal row after the intro on tablet and phone.

editorial.legal-body.description: Legal rich-text body: numbered h5 headings, sub-headings, paragraphs and disc lists with fixed 32/40/12px spacing.

support.faq.description: 'Questions, answered.' FAQ: sticky left column with learn-more text and About us link, an accordion of questions (item 1 open on desktop, 0.8s tween, plus rotates to 135°, #f7f7f7 hover backdrop) and an 'Ask a question' button.

templates.name: Project case study (last, no next project)
